channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: ACCA warns of serious threat to public safety funding from SSUT litigation
item.description: New data shows Alabama counties face spending nearly $1 billion this year on sheriff’s offices and jails, relying heavily on threatened state tax revenue.

item.title: Opinion | When rural health care outpaces Alabama law
item.description: New care models emerged from necessity across rural Alabama, yet state laws treating EMS mainly as transport created significant legal friction.

item.title: Dakarai Larriett talks Senate campaign, Democratic primary, ongoing lawsuit and more
item.description: Larriett detailed his campaign's growth, fundraising success and coordination with Democratic groups, while discussing his lawsuit against Michigan State Police.

item.title: Rep. Collins education bills advance, targeting literacy, teachers and workforce gaps
item.description: Lawmakers advanced three of Collins's education bills expanding literacy programs, addressing teacher shortages, and supporting adults returning to college and work.

item.title: Senate advances bill elevating assaults on public officials to a felony
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee advanced a bill making assaults on public officials felonies, adding protections for pharmacists and nurses after debate.

item.title: Opinion | The myth of the oppressed white man
item.description: Donald Trump said that white people have been treated very poorly since the Civil Rights Act passed. Let's take a look at that.

item.title: Alabama Senate committee advances prostate cancer screening legislation
item.description: The bipartisan measure requires insurance companies to cover all costs of prostate cancer screenings for high-risk patients across Alabama.

item.title: Alabama House committee OKs squat truck ban, police retirement bill
item.description: During its first 2026 meeting, a House committee reviewed a slew of law enforcement and vehicle regulation bills, advancing five measures.

item.title: Gov. Ivey proposes modest budgets as financial experts warn of looming downturn
item.description: Lawmakers will consider less ambitious budgets this session after state financial experts warned that COVID-era revenue streams are drying up.

item.title: Committee approves bill to allow death penalty in cases of child rape
item.description: The death penalty would be applied in situations where the victim is under 12 years of age.
